types.name: R_GPT_POEG0_Type
types.note: Four POEG groups have a 0x100-byte instance stride. Only POEGG is implemented in this target; sibling GTONCWP/GTONCCR and CDRE4/CDRE5 are not present.

members.name: POEGG
members.note: PIDF/IOCF/OSTPF are write-zero-to-clear; PIDE/IOCE/OSTPE/CDRE0–3 are writable only once after reset.

types.name: R_ACMPHS0_Type
types.note: Original FSP5.9 CMPMON field spelling corresponds to target COMPMON. CSTEN and VREFEN are implemented only in channel 0. CRVS is four bits on RA8P1, not the six bits of some siblings.

types.name: R_DRW_Type
types.note: CONTROL/STATUS and CONTROL2/HWREVISION share addresses but have distinct write/read meanings. Original FSP5.9 READFORMAT32/READFORMAT10/WRITEFORMAT10/TEXCLU spellings denote target READFORMAT_H/READFORMAT_L/WRITEFORMAT/TEXCLUT fields.

types.name: R_CEU_Type
types.note: Plane A, plane B and unused-plane mirror registers use the exact baseline scalar _B/_M names. Target CBWER at +0xA0 is not aliased to legacy AXIBUSCTL2: target BWE is one bit while legacy AWCACHE is four bits. CDSSR is read-only per §61.2.24 despite the summary table marking it R/W.
